lines.description: Stainless steel 304 sheet, 0.0625 in (16 ga), 48 in x 96 in
lines.clarification_question: No match in the current catalog for 304 stainless steel sheet, 0.0625 in (16 ga), 48 in x 96 in. Should we quote it from an outside source at a stated lead time, or remove this line?
lines.notes: No match in the current catalog, which holds aviation bolts only. The reading itself is clear.

material.explanation: SS is the common abbreviation for stainless steel.

thickness.explanation: 16 gauge on the stainless steel gauge table is 0.0625 in. On the mild steel table it would be 0.0598 in. It is not 0.060 in.

width.explanation: 4 ft by 8 ft, converted to 48 in by 96 in. The first number is read as width.

length.explanation: 4 ft by 8 ft, converted to 48 in by 96 in. The second number is read as length.

quantity.explanation: Quantity and unit stated by the buyer.

compliance.label: Mill test report required
compliance.note: Buyer asked outright. No match in the current catalog, so MTR availability is unknown.

assumptions: ASTM A240 is the usual specification family for 304 sheet. It is not stated in the RFQ.
Finish is not stated. 2B is the usual mill finish for 304 sheet.
4x8 is read as feet, the usual sheet size notation. 48 in x 96 in.
rules_used: Gauge table: stainless steel, 16 ga = 0.0625 in.
Unit conversion: 4 ft x 8 ft = 48 in x 96 in.

match.reason: The sample catalog contains aviation bolts only. No sheet items.
